comment: brief TRN-7 R-trn7-2. Upstream's own Windows build of ngspice 41, the release the conda-forge recipes install too, from its old-releases folder, whose address does not move when a newer release comes out. Upstream publishes the archive as .7z only, which the assistant unpacks itself (SevenZip.cs). The archive's layout (Spice64/bin/ngspice_con.exe) was read with the assistant's own 7z reader; the unpacked program ran under Wine 10 in a Debian x64 container (2026-11-15), where circuitRF's win-x64 CLI found it at C:\Spice64\bin and solved the testdata/transient/ngspice benches with it. The download itself is untested there (that Wine could not validate any TLS certificate), and nothing has run on Windows itself.
layoutNote: Upstream's binary archive: one folder, Spice64, holding the program, its code models and its scripts, which nothing outside it names, so the home is built in .partial and renamed into place.
consentNotes: ngspice is free software under the modified BSD licence, with parts under other free licences listed in its own documentation; circuitRF starts it as a separate program and distributes nothing.

measured.source: the archive is 6.9 MB; not measured on Windows
